name: Myōken Shrine
text: Shinto shrine in Tokushima Prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Myoken Shrine
depictions.text: Myoken Shrine was a Shinto shrine in southwestern Kii, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the shrine, climbed up a wayward tree, and oversaw the land below them.
